technique_name: Outline the possible access control policies for a cloud-based application.
description: The access control policies for a cloud-based application can include policy-based access control, role-based access control, attribute-based access control, identity-based access control, and authentication-based access control. Policy-based access control uses predetermined rules to grant permissions for a user's activity. Role-based access control manages user permissions based on the user's assigned role.
